summary.text: Taylor Royal is a nonpartisan candidate for Nebraska State Senate District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election, for an open seat, facing Jess Goldoni.
Royal is a certified public accountant with a master's degree in accounting from Southern Methodist University.

paragraphs.text: Taylor Royal ran in the 2017 primary for mayor of Omaha and finished third with 10.78 percent of the vote, behind Jean Stothert and Heath Mello.
His campaign website that year listed modernizing city services, including a plan for outsourcing, and revitalizing North Omaha among its themes.
In 2018, Royal lost the Republican primary for Nebraska Treasurer to John Murante, 43.6 percent to 56.4 percent.
In the May 12, 2026 primary for District 18, Royal advanced with 32.6 percent of the vote, second behind Goldoni.
